notes: Multi-ratio checks (CHK-023, 025, 026, 034) use @cocotb.parametrize. CHK-029 picks one ratio per seed. The extra synchronizer latency can't be forced to 0 from the testbench. In CHK-025/026 a strict bound is checked when crossing counts don't vary; otherwise the measured extras are allowed and not_verifiable is called. not_verifiable is also called for config-dependent parts (APB5, HS_TYPE, CFG-MIN, CELL_TYPE=4). In CHK-027 the read runs before the write so o_apb_pwrite is nonzero at the async reset. Not compiled or simulated.
